solutions.title: Iterative Fibonacci DP
solutions.description:
**Approach:** `ways(i) = ways(i-1) + ways(i-2)`; iterate with two rolling variables.

**Why preferred:** Shows DP without recursion or a global cache; what most interviewers want after Fibonacci recognition.

**Example walkthrough:** Ways(`3`) = ways(`2`) + ways(`1`) = `2 + 1 = 3`, computed bottom-up with two rolling variables.

solutions.title: Memoized recursion (Fibonacci)
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Recurse `f(n)=f(n-1)+f(n-2)` with a shared `calculations` map.

**vs recommended:** Correct DP insight. Module-level cache can leak across calls in tests/servers — prefer a local Map or bottom-up loop for interview code.

**Example walkthrough:** Same Fibonacci recurrence with memo: `climb(3)` caches `climb(2)+climb(1)`.
